name: Variation Swatches for WooCommerce
author: TaskPlugins

sections.description:
Variation Swatches for WooCommerce is a lightweight WordPress plugin designed to upgrade standard WooCommerce product attribute dropdown menus into interactive visual swatches. Instead of selecting options like color or size from plain dropdown menus, customers can choose options using color circles, checkbox, or radio buttons. The plugin enhances the WooCommerce shopping experience.

👉 Plugin Demo | Documentation | Get Pro 👈

Core Features & Highlights

✨ Multiple Swatch Display Types: Convert default dropdowns into radio buttons, color circles, checkbox swatches, or standard HTML dropdowns.

✨ Global & Product-Level Controls: Configure settings globally via WordPress Admin → Tools → Variation Swatches or customize them per product under the product editor tab when global override is turned off.

✨ Flexible Attribute Shapes: Customize attribute swatches in rounded or square shapes to fit your store theme.

✨ Seamless Compatibility: Built lightweight to integrate natively with WordPress and WooCommerce without conflicting with major themes or plugins.

How to Work Settings with Swatches.

✨ Attribute Shape: Radio — The Radio provides a sleek, clear display for individual attributes.
👉 Live Demo | Documentation

✨ Attribute Shape: Select ( Default ) — Set and display default attribute values with ease using sleek drop-down selectors.
👉 Live Demo | Documentation

✨ Attribute Shape: Checkbox (Pro) — The Checkbox provides a sleek, clear display for individual attributes.
👉 Live Demo | Documentation

✨ Attribute Shape: Checkbox and Radio (Pro) — Display attributes seamlessly across your UI with clear Checkbox and Radio controls.
👉 Live Demo | Documentation

Compatibility

Variation swathces for Woocommerce plugin is integrated into WooCommerce and WordPress, but only where necessary. It’s unlikely to conflict with other plugins.

Need Any Help?

👉 For any bug, support or suggestion please submit your ticket here.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the variation swatches for woocommerce folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Navigate to WordPress Admin Panel → Tools → Variation Swatches to set the variation swatches settings.
  4. Go to WooCommerce product to Add New or Edit products.
sections.faq:
How to Use WooCommerce Variation Swatches

  • Go to WordPress Admin Panel → Tools → Variation Swatches

Is it compatible with any kinds of WooCommerce Theme?

Yes, it is compatible with Most popular WooCommerce themes , but need some css update.

How do I configure product attributes as swatches?

  • Go to WordPress Admin Panel → Products → Attributes.
    • Fill out the attribute form and select your desired attribute type (such as Color).
    • Click Add Attribute. You can then configure individual terms and set visual values.

Can I customize swatch shapes to match my store’s theme?

Yes, the plugin supports flexible attribute shapes allowing you to easily switch between rounded (circular) or square styles to fit your store design

How do I adjust product-specific variation swatches settings?

  • Edit or Add your chosen Variable Product from WordPress Admin Panel → Products.
  • Look for the Variation Swatches tab inside the Product Data panel.
  • Choose your preferred attribute shapes, then click Save Changes.

How do global override settings work?

If you want uniform styling across your entire store, you can enable global overrides.

  • Go to WordPress Admin Panel → Tools → Variation Swatches → Settings.
  • Configure your options for attribute shapes.
  • Save settings. When override is enabled, it applies globally and overrides individual product-level configuration.

Where can I get support if I encounter bugs or issues?

If you face any issues, need technical help, or want to submit suggestions, you can open a support ticket via the official TaskPlugins Support Ticket Portal.
